variant.title: Thermometer Sudoku
variant.description: Digits must strictly increase from each thermometer bulb to its tip.
rule.thermometer_order: Digits must strictly increase along the thermometer.
rule_guide.title: Thermometer Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Digits on each thermometer must strictly increase from bulb to tip.
